{{Top|leg}}
'''Chief designer''' was a title held by an individual who led the designing of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], used by [[Abhean Shipyards]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Felmas]] held this title, at the same time they were [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of the company.<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
